key_classes.name: GitLabDriver
key_classes.fallback: Delegates to GitDriver when API auth fails or insufficient permissions

key_relationships: VcsRepository factory-creates VcsDriver concrete instances (driver map by type)
VcsRepository delegates metadata fetching to VcsDriverInterface
GitLabDriver extends VcsDriver; falls back to GitDriver on auth failure
VcsDownloader uses source URLs from VcsDriver.getSource() to download packages
GitLabDriver uses GitLab utility for OAuth authorization flow
important_notes: VcsRepository auto-detects driver by calling driver::supports(io, config, url). GitLabDriver uses GitLab API v4; falls back to GitDriver (git clone) for auth failures, insufficient permissions, or non-interactive mode. PerforceDriver is registered but not in suggested files. VcsDownloader is in Downloader namespace (separate from Repository/Vcs); uses 'source' install mode. Caching keyed by 40-char hex commit SHA.
